headline: Congress named a Texas post office in New Braunfels after former congressman Bob Krueger.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 651 Business Interstate Highway 35 North, Suite 420, in New Braunfels, Texas. The building will be officially called the Bob Krueger Post Office. The law does not change postal services, fees, or mail rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 27, 2022.
